observations.body: Believers take disputes before outside judges. Dare any of you, having a matter against his neighbor, go to law before the unrighteous, and not before the saints? No, but you yourselves do wrong and defraud, and that against your brothers.

payload.posture: Read 1 Corinthians 6:1–8 as one movement in Paul's story, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states believers take disputes before outside judges. Dare any of you, having a matter against his neighbor, go to law before the unrighteous, and not before the saints? No, but you yourselves do wrong and defraud, and that against your brothers. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of Paul's story.
